What it is

What gutter cleaning involves

Gutters fill from the top down, and the blockage you cannot see from the ground is the one that overflows. A proper clean is the full run of gutter plus every downpipe, not just the handful of spots reachable from a ladder.

We clear the gutters by hand, flush the downpipes through, and confirm the water actually leaves the roof. While we are up there we flag any rust, sag or split so a small gutter problem does not become a roof one.

Questions

Gutter cleaning questions

How much does gutter cleaning cost?

It is priced on the size and type of the roof and how long since the last clean. Send a photo of the house for a fixed price, usually without coming out.

How often should gutters be cleaned?

Most Melbourne homes need it twice a year, before winter and before summer. Homes under heavy tree cover need it more often.

Do you clean two storey gutters?

Yes. We are set up and insured for single and double storey, and we do the hard runs rather than leaving them.

Do you install gutter guards?

We do. If the gutters fill quickly under trees, guards cut how often they need clearing, and we can quote both together.
